set.body: Goal: keep PlotCompiler.compile/resolve as the facade but factor internals into explicit phases: mapping resolution, scale resolution, row evaluation, geom lowering, guide resolution, and scene assembly. Acceptance: phase types are inspectable and testable; compiler behavior stays compatible; row diagnostics and resolved layer metadata survive the refactor; geom lowering becomes group-aware -- layers honor the group aesthetic and per-group graphic params (today Geom.Line takes rows.head.gp for the whole polyline, silently ignoring row-level color/alpha mappings), so a multi-group line layer lowers to one grob per group with that group's params, covered by tests; focused JVM/JS graphics and SVG tests pass.
